## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the small slanted-edged brown seal, press onto Blue

Task description: Pick up the small brown sloped-edge stamp on the right side of the table and press it onto the blue square block to its left.

Success criteria: The stamp is aligned near the center of the blue block on the table, pressed and left there, and both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Grasp the stamp on opposite straight sides, keeping the pads away from sloped edges and clear of the base, reducing slipping or the fingers hitting the table before pressing.
- Set the opening slightly wider than the selected grasp area. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the stamp rather than merely overlapping in the image and pushing it over from one side.
- When pressing, keep the stamp's bottom face flat against the tabletop at the blue mark. Near contact, lower in small steps with little lateral movement to avoid landing on an edge or scraping it out of position.
- Before release, confirm the stamp is stably supported by the table. Watch whether the pads move it as they open, to avoid losing the aligned position.
